website.readmeExcerpt:
# Snowcloak Sync
The snow may cloak the world in silence, but come in, warm up, and reveal your true colours.

A Dalamud plugin.

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1408265972720078990?color=5865F2&label=discord&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/elznmods)

## Usage and Installation

For details on how to use Snowcloak, including install instructions, give our [docs](https://docs.snowcloak-sync.com) a read!
